messages:
Ivy (Design): dropped a compact prototype for the latency dashboard tweaks. goals: keyboard-first scrubber, persistent p95 chip while scrubbing, clear "Sample rate" microcopy, and a patterned overlay toggle for colorblind users. figma: https://figma.com/... :eyes:
Marco (PM): looks good. product Q: when to auto-apply sampling? still >24h / >1M rows? should we show a brief banner + a persistent tag on p95 or only the tag?
Tess (Frontend): agree on banner + tag. impl notes: scrubbing currently triggers heavy queries; propose debounce pointer=120ms, keyboard=60ms. avoid refetch when only bucket offset changes. we'll expose `meta.sampled` in heatmap payload so badge is client-only.
Rex (SRE): agree on debounce. add client smoothing 1.8s for p95 visual to reduce bucket-hop. telemetry: emit `viz.sampling_applied`, `viz.p95_sticky_click` with reason (range/rows).
June (A11y): a11y nits:
- scrubber must be role="slider" with arrow/shift+arrow/pageup/pagedown and aria-valuetext like "From 14:00 to 15:00"
- when sampling toggles announce via aria-live polite: "Sampling active: results may be approximate"
- patterned overlay toggle must be accessible and labelled "Colorblind overlay"
Ivy (Design): copy proposal: label="Sample rate" tooltip="Applied to large ranges to reduce query cost; values may be approximate." p95 tag: "sampled" when sampling>0.
Marco (PM): short copy approved. banner text idea: "Sampling applied — values may be approximate" (auto-dismiss 5s).
Tess (Frontend): locking debounce=120ms pointer, 60ms keyboard, smoothing=1.8s. will send PR with keyboard focus order: presets -> scrubber -> sampling control -> p95 chip.
Rex (SRE): i'll add telemetry and a Grafana panel for `viz.sampling_applied`. include reason tags to filter.
June (A11y): i'll test NVDA + VoiceOver and verify aria-live announcements and focus order.
design-bot: created PR #6321 for "keyboard-scrubber + sampled-badge" and assigned @Tess @June :robot_face:
Ivy (Design): thanks all — next: Tess implements PR, June reviews a11y, Rex wires telemetry, Marco signs off on copy. will update figma after PR merges :sparkles:
